name: How does view selection impact the price of a pre-construction unit?

mainEntity.name: How does view selection impact the price of a pre-construction unit?

acceptedAnswer.text: View selection significantly impacts the price of a pre-construction unit. Units with unobstructed, desirable views—such as direct ocean views in Sunny Isles Beach, Intracoastal views, or city skyline views in areas like Downtown Miami—typically command a premium. This premium reflects both the aesthetic value and the potential for higher resale value. Buyers often weigh the added cost against the long-term enjoyment and investment potential of a prime view.
acceptedAnswer.description: Units with desirable, unobstructed views typically command a higher price in pre-construction properties due to aesthetic and investment value.
